Union Health Minister Nadda interacts with MPs from Jharkhand and Odisha to strengthen efforts towards TB Mukt Bharat

NEW DELHI: Union health minister JP Nadda was admitted to AIIMS Delhi on Thursday evening after experiencing uneasiness, the hospital said. Nadda was evaluated and underwent tests, including a coronary angiography. He is currently stable and has been admitted to the Department of Cardiology for observation, AIIMS said.

End of Article

title: 'China stopped our army from patrolling several places in Arunachal': Rahul
content: "this is extremely alarming," Rahul Gandhi says in a post on X . he also questioned the silence of defence minister Rajnath Singh, home minister Amit Shah ji and prime minister Narendra Modi on the issue .

title: 'Our red line': Shehbaz Sharif threatens India with 'direct response' over Indus Water Treaty
content: shehbaz Sharif threatens a 'direct response' to new Delhi's move . he said the move came days after the Pahalgam terror attack in jammu and Kashmir . new Delhi has proved itsel to keep the IWT in abeyance following the attack .

title: Savarkar defamation case: SC quashes Lucknow Court order summoning Rahul
content: the defamation case stems from Rahul Gandhi’s remarks about VD Savarkar . the leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha had challenged td savarkar in 2022 . a bench of the high court held that the required sanction had not been obtained .

title: Harsimrat Badal 'deeply touched' by PM Modi's 'kind gesture' after attack on Sukhbir Badal
content: sukhbir Singh Badal was attacked at a gurdwara in Maharashtra's Nanded . the former deputy chief minister was attacked a day earlier . she thanked the prime minister for taking immediate cognisance of the incident .

title: Phuket-Delhi A320 which plunged 300 feet lost flight controls for 4 seconds: Probe
content: airbus says the aircraft experienced a sudden loss in altitude that left 24 injured . the aircraft's autopilot was disconnected and the aircraft’s nose went up (increase in pitch) all timings are in IST .

title: 'Uncalled for': CJI pulls up Bar Council of India over threat of action against NALSAR students
content: a section of students objected to the university inviting Chief Justice of India Surya Kant as the chief guest at its convocation ceremony . the enrolment of 2026 graduates of Hyderabad's NALSAR university of law was revoked by the bar Council of India .

title: 4 dead as ‘unprecedented’ rain floods Japan, strands thousands at Narita Airport
content: a man believed to be in his 60s or 70s was found floating on a flooded road . a woman, 66, was trapped in her submerged car, officials said . another man, whose age was not immediately known, was found collapsed . the identity of the fourth victim remained unclear .
